title: REIT Portfolio Risk & Allocation

blueprintSignals.name: De-smoothed volatility
blueprintSignals.definition: standard deviation of returns after an autoregressive correction for appraisal smoothing
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Depends on the smoothing model, so test its sensitivity

blueprintSignals.name: Sector correlation
blueprintSignals.definition: rolling correlation of de-smoothed returns between sectors
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Short histories make correlations unstable, so use shrinkage

blueprintSignals.name: Lease expiry concentration
blueprintSignals.definition: share of income expiring in any one year across the portfolio
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Break options change the dates, so include them

blueprintSignals.name: Leverage
blueprintSignals.definition: loan-to-value ratio at asset and portfolio level using current valuations
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Definitions differ between lenders, so use one convention

label: For "REIT Portfolio Risk & Allocation": Estimate portfolio risk across properties and sectors and recommend allocation changes within mandate limits.
